title: CPU Flags & How Comparisons Work
description:
## The Flags Register
The CPU stores comparison results in FLAGS. `cmp` doesn't store a value - it sets flags.

Important flags:
- **ZF** (Zero Flag) - set if values are equal
- **SF** (Sign Flag) - set if result is negative
- **CF** (Carry Flag) - for unsigned overflow
